lines.en: My God, these pants, I'm burning up.
Oh, come on, she wants to snuggle now?
What, is she trying to kill me?
It's like a volcano in here.
Okay, must just be me then.
That was just the pants on the couch.
Um, hey, do you mind if I use your bathroom?
Hey, my favorite part's coming up.
No, I got really hot in my leather pants,
but they must have shrunk from the sweat or something,
or my legs expanded from the heat.
But I can't get them back on, Joey.
Oh, that is quite a situation.
Uh, do you see any, like, powder?
Sprinkle some of that on your legs.
It'll absorb some of the moisture,
and then you can get your pants back on.
Throw some of that on there.
They're still, they're still not coming on, man,
and the lotion and the powder have made a paste.
Well, I'm just, if the paste matches the pants,
you can make yourself a pair of paste pants,
and she won't know the difference.
Joey, do you have a minute?
Uh, Rachel's here, so good luck, man.
Let me know how it works out.
Oh, Joey, I have such a problem.
Uh, well, your timing couldn't be better.
I am putting out fires all over the place today.
Boss, um, you've been in there for a long time.
I'm starting to get kind of freaked out.
Hey, can you turn the lights off?
No, let's just leave the lights on.
